title: Claude 4 (Opus 4 and Sonnet 4)
before: Coding agents worked in short bursts and lost the thread on longer tasks.
problem: Real engineering tasks run for hours and require holding context across many steps.
breakthrough: Hybrid reasoning models tuned for sustained agentic work, reported at 72.5% on SWE-bench Verified.
why: It set the agentic coding bar for the year and made multi-hour autonomous tasks a selling point. The benchmark figures are vendor-reported.
next: The 4.5 line in late 2025, then Claude 5 in 2026.
inherits: Long-horizon agentic work as the thing frontier models compete on.
